name: Kurnoth's Heralds
inspire: After an Action step, if a friendly fighter began that Action step in friendly territory and then made a successful Attack, Inspire that fighter.

reactions.name: Swift Sentinels
reactions.flavorText: Perfectly attuned to the Hunter's Paradise, Kurnoth's Heralds run circles around intruders who dare stray into their territory.
reactions.rulesText: While they are in friendly territory, friendly fighters have the Flying ({icon:fly}) runemark and cannot be Flanked (they can still be Surrounded).

abilities.name: The Endless Hunt
abilities.trigger: Use this immediately after a friendly fighter has Attacked.
abilities.flavorText: Kurnoth's faithful rarely slow and never stand still, for the hunt never ends.
abilities.rulesText: You can push the attacker up to 2 hexes. You can only use this ability once per game.

abilities.name: Precision Volley
abilities.trigger: Use this immediately after a friendly Lenwythe's ranged Attack.
abilities.flavorText: Some of the greatest archers in the realms reside within Kurnotheal, and Lenwythe can outshoot most of them.
abilities.rulesText: That fighter Attacks again using the same weapon. You can only use this ability once per game.

abilities.name: Herald's Pride
abilities.trigger: Use this immediately after you pick a weapon as part of your leader's ({icon:leader}) Attack.
abilities.flavorText: Ylarin has the arrogance of a warrior born, but few that have witnessed his martial prowess would deny his glory.
abilities.rulesText: That weapon has Cleave ({icon:cleave}) and Ensnare ({icon:ensnare}) for that Attack. You can only use this ability once per game.

playstyle: Three Sylvaneth elites with five health apiece but only single-dice saves, making each loss costly. In friendly territory they gain Flying and cannot be Flanked, so the band fights best on home ground, and fighters Inspire by striking from there, gaining extra hammer dice, Cleave and Stagger. Once-per-game tricks add punch: a post-attack push, a second Lenwythe volley and Ylarin's Cleave-and-Ensnare strike. The warband wins by holding its territory, picking off intruders and controlling objectives close to home.
